privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your personal data in Splitly.
privacy.body: We collect only what is needed to run shared expenses: account details, group membership, and expense data you enter. Data is stored securely and is visible only to members of your groups, according to the permissions in the app.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.subtitle: Rules for using Splitly.
terms.body: By using Splitly you agree to use the service lawfully and to keep your login credentials secure. The app helps track shared expenses; recorded settlements reflect what you confirm — always verify real-world payments between people.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.subtitle: Cookies and similar technologies.
cookies.body: We use essential cookies and local storage to keep you signed in and remember preferences (such as language). We do not use third-party advertising cookies.

gdpr.title: GDPR
gdpr.subtitle: Your rights under EU data protection law.
gdpr.body: If you are in the European Economic Area, you may request access, correction, portability, or deletion of your personal data, and object to certain processing.
gdpr.point1: Contact us using the Contact link below for any request.
gdpr.point2: You may also delete your account data from Settings where available.
gdpr.point3: We respond to verified requests within the timeframes required by law.

deleteData.title: Delete your data
deleteData.subtitle: How to remove your information from Splitly.
deleteData.body: You can sign out at any time. To remove your account and associated personal data, contact us or use account options in Settings when available.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Questions, support, or privacy requests.
contact.body: For help using Splitly, open Support & Help in the app. For privacy or data requests, email our team at the address shown in your organisation’s documentation or product website.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Quick answers to help you understand how things work

balances.question: How are balances calculated?
balances.answer: We track who paid and who participated in each expense. Your balance reflects the difference between what you paid and your share.
balances.point1: If you paid more -> people owe you
balances.point2: If you paid less -> you owe others

draft.question: What’s a draft expense?
draft.answer: A draft expense is still in planning. It won’t affect balances until you confirm it.
draft.point1: Use drafts to plan trips, dinners, or shared costs before finalizing.

groups.question: Do I need to invite people?
groups.answer: Yes — balances only work with shared participants.
groups.point1: Invite people so expenses can be split correctly.

events.question: What’s the difference between an event and a group?
events.answer: A group is your ongoing circle (friends, team, etc). An event is a specific moment inside a group (trip, dinner, etc.).

settle.question: What does “settle up” mean?
settle.answer: It means recording payments between people to clear debts.
settle.point2: The group is fully up to date

privacy.question: Is my data safe?
privacy.answer: Yes — your data is private and only visible to your groups.

expenses.question: Why doesn’t my expense affect balances?
expenses.point1: If your expense is still in draft, confirm it so it can count toward balances.
